latestVersion.changelog:
Photo Video Maker Fast - Initial Release

- Instantly turn JPG, PNG, HEIC, or WEBP photos (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 slideshow videos in 30–60 seconds using cloud GPUs.
- Simple chat-based workflow: upload images, give instructions (e.g., "turn my photos into a slideshow"), and download finished videos.
- Automatic backend setup and authentication, with easy anonymous token sign-up for 100 free credits (7-day validity).
- Supports quick edits, batch processing, session-based iteration, and live status updates.
- Built-in error handling for issues like token expiration, unsupported files, and export limits.
- Exports available as MP4 by default; additional formats supported.
